roles.title: Product Manager (Platform & AI Agents)
roles.description:
About League

League is one of the fastest-growing technology companies in Canada and the leading healthcare experience platform. Getting healthcare is often the easy part — finishing it is where things fall apart: people book the appointment and skip the follow-up, fill the prescription and stop taking it, get the referral and never make the call. That gap costs health plans and health systems money, and it costs people their health. League closes that gap — identifying what each person needs to do next, clearing what’s in their way, and getting it done, for the 70 million+ people whose care already runs through our platform. Health plans and health systems trust us to do this at scale. Organizations like Manulife, SCAN, Geisinger, and Medibank on the payer side, and Baptist and Shoppers Drug Mart on the provider side.

Position Summary:

League's platform enables our customers to offer highly engaging, personalized healthcare experiences to their members. As a Product Manager II, you will own defined problem spaces within our Member & Patient Portals and AI Agent Teams — spanning benefits navigation, care finding, messaging, scheduling, care gaps, and condition management. You'll operate the full PM role across 1–2 engineering pods with growing independence, working closely with a Solution Owner and Staff PMs to turn ambiguous problems into clear, outcome-oriented bets. This role is calibrated for someone early in their PM career (around 2 years of relevant experience) who is ready to own a scope independently while still building toward Senior PM

In this role, you will:

Own problem framing and success metrics for defined bets within platform surfaces (e.g., benefits & claims, care finding, messaging, scheduling, Care Navigation Agent, Benefits Navigation Agent, Health Coach Agent, Care Gaps Agent)

Operate independently across 1–2 pods, growing toward full ownership of 2 pods over time

Bring domain signal and customer insight to your Solution Owner without being prompted; join upstream conversations on bet shaping

Define clear, scoped problem statements and outcome-oriented success metrics the pod can act on without needing to ask

Communicate bet intent clearly to your pod; spot and raise blockers, building the instinct to unblock without over-owning delivery

Surface when a bet's goal or box is at risk; escalate to Product Desk appropriately and distinguish delivery noise from bet-level signal

Build foundational knowledge of League's platform, digital provider and payer market, and the League AI product line; answer domain questions from your pod with growing confidence

Define KPIs, validate problem framing with data, and track bet performance against goals

Use AI tools (prompt engineering, research/synthesis, discovery prep) to accelerate bet framing, market research, and metric definition — use AI ethically and in line with League's data privacy policies

Contribute to interviews and onboarding for APM/PM-level hires as needed

About You:

2+ years of Product Management or related technology delivery experience

Exposure to AI Platforms, no-code agent builders and frontier models, etc

Comfortable operating with real ambiguity and turning it into a scoped problem statement and metrics without heavy hand-holding

Working knowledge of agile methodologies and comfort partnering with engineering and design in sprint ceremonies

Practical experience using AI tools for productivity (drafting, research, synthesis) and a genuine interest in building deeper AI fluency

Strong written and verbal communication skills — able to clearly explain trade-offs to your pod and Solution Owner

A track record of seeking feedback proactively and applying it quickly

Attributes & Characteristics

Clear, confident communicator and writer

Strong problem solver who distinguishes problems from solutions

Brings domain signal proactively rather than waiting for direction

Building foundational knowledge of League's platform, architecture, and the payer/digital health market

Comfortable with agile development processes

Creates space for teammates to contribute; listens with curiosity

Growth-minded — actively seeks feedback and coaching, and applies it visibly

Curious about and comfortable experimenting with AI tools in day-to-day PM work

What we offer:

Comprehensive Health Benefits: We prioritize your well-being with complete medical, dental, and vision coverage

Bonus Program: Be rewarded for your contributions with our performance-based bonus program

Employee Stock Option Program: Become an owner and share in our success through our stock option program

Unlimited Paid Time Off: Take the time you need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance

Spending Accounts: Manage your healthcare and dependent care expenses with tax-advantaged spending accounts

Wellness Days: Prioritize your mental and physical health with dedicated wellness days throughout the year

Growth Opportunities: We invest in your future with abundant opportunities for professional development and advancement

Mentorship Program: Benefit from guidance and support from experienced leaders in your field

Security-Related Responsibilities

Ensure access management is performed in compliance with the employee's role and responsibilities

Responsibility and accountability for executing League's policies and procedures within the department/ team

Notification of HR, Legal, Compliance & Security of any incidents, breaches or policy violations

Compliance with Information Security Policies

CANADA APPLICANTS ONLY: The Canada-specific compensation range below for this full-time position is exclusive of bonus, equity and benefits. This range reflects the minimum and maximum target for base salaries for the position across all Canadian locations. The salary range is intentional to account for the performance and career progressions a Leaguer will experience in the role throughout their time at League. Where in the band you may land is determined by job-related skills/experience. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range specific to your skills and experience during the hiring process.

Compensation range for Canada applicants only

$100,800—$126,000 CAD

AI Fluency & Ways of Working

At League, we are an AI-native organization. We expect all employees regardless of role or level to thoughtfully leverage AI to improve the quality, speed, and impact of their work.

What this means in practice:

Use AI tools as part of your daily workflow to enhance productivity, problem-solving, and decision-making (e.g., drafting, analysis, coding, research, or process automation)

Apply judgment and accountability when using AI by reviewing outputs for accuracy, bias, and quality before use

Continuously learn and adapt as new AI tools and capabilities emerge, incorporating them into your ways of working

Identify opportunities to improve how work gets done from personal productivity to team-level workflows by leveraging AI effectively

Operate with strong data responsibility and security awareness, especially when working with sensitive or regulated information

How this scales by level:

Individual Contributors: Use AI to improve personal productivity and quality of output

Senior ICs / Managers: Integrate AI into team workflows and improve processes

Leaders: Drive AI adoption at the organizational level and shape how work is done across teams

What we look for:

Demonstrated experience using AI tools in a practical, responsible way

Curiosity and openness to experimenting with new technologies

Ability to balance efficiency with quality and sound judgment

Our employees come from different backgrounds, and we celebrate those differences. We are looking for the best candidates for our open roles, but do not expect applicants to meet every qualification in order to be considered. If you are excited about what you could accomplish at League and believe you can add value to our team, we would love to hear from you.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you are an individual in need of assistance at any time during our recruitment process, please contact us at recruitinginfo@league.com.

Our Application Process:

Applying to a role you love can be exhausting, and understanding the next steps can feel vague and uncertain. You have done the hard part of submitting your application; let's do ours by sharing potential next steps

You should receive a confirmation email after submitting your application.

A recruiter (not a computer) reviews all applications at League.

If we see alignment with League's needs, a recruiter will reach out to learn more about your goals. The recruiter will also share the team-specific interview process depending on the roles you are exploring.

The final step is an offer, which we hope you will accept!

Prior to joining us, we conduct reference and background checks. Additional checks could be required for US Candidates, depending on the role you are exploring.

Here are some additional resources to learn more about League:

Learn about our platform, leadership team and partners

Highmark Health, Google Cloud, League: new digital front door to seamless care

Former Providence President and Workday EVP of Corporate Strategy join League Board of Directors

League raises $95 million USD in Series C to build world’s leading healthcare CX platform

Forbes x League: The Platformization Of Healthcare Is Here

Fast Company x League: If we want better innovations in healthtech, we need more competition

Work Location:

We have a mix of office-centric roles based in our vibrant Toronto office, and remote-eligible roles based anywhere in Canada or US. Each job posting will indicate where the role will be based. Regardless of the role’s posted location, all Toronto-area Leaguers (living within 65 km of our downtown HQ) collaborate in-office Monday through Thursday. Depending on your distance to the office, you’ll enjoy 10 or 20 Flexible Remote Days each quarter for focus and deep-work time. We are committed to fostering a meaningful work environment and connections for all Leaguers regardless of location.

Recognize and Avoid Employment scams. Practice safe job searching.

Scammers are getting craftier and leveraging fake job postings to get personal information. Know the warning signs and protect yourself from scammers. Learn more here.

Use of AI Notice
We are committed to ensuring fairness and transparency throughout our hiring process. League may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools to assist in the screening of applicants for this position. Please check out our stance on using AI in recruitment here.

Privacy Policy

Review our Privacy Policy for information on how League is protecting personal data.

roles.title: Senior Product Manager, Social & Community
roles.description:
BUILD SOMETHING PEOPLE LOVE

Wealthsimple is Canada’s leading financial innovator. The company offers a full suite of simple, sophisticated financial products across managed investing, do-it-yourself trading, cryptocurrency, tax filing, spending and saving. Wealthsimple currently serves more than 4 million Canadians and holds over $155 billion in assets under administration. The company was founded in 2014 by a team of financial experts and technology entrepreneurs, and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.

We're proud of what we've built — and we're just getting started. Read our Culture Manual https://www.wealthsimple.com/en-ca/culture and learn more about how we work https://www.wealthsimple.com/en-ca/careers.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Product Manager to turn social sharing and community into real growth engines for Wealthsimple.

You'll own products like screenshot sharing, WealthRank, Portfolio Pulse, and Profiles — and dream up new ways for clients to show off their progress, learn from each other, and bring their friends along.

This is product, growth, and community, all in one seat. Your job isn't just shipping features — it's building the loops that make people want to come back, share, and invite others. You'll set the vision, own the roadmap, and be accountable for the numbers that matter: engagement, virality, retention, and new clients.

We're looking for someone with sharp consumer product instincts and a real feel for social behaviour and network effects. Someone comfortable developing a long-term product vision, studying why something spreads, digging into behavioural data, and working with design and engineering to ship the next experiment.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Set the strategy and vision for social sharing and community at Wealthsimple, establishing how these experiences contribute to engagement, virality, retention, and new-client growth.

- Own and grow features such as screenshot sharing, WealthRank, Portfolio Pulse, and Profiles, while developing new social and community experiences from the ground up.

- Build product-led growth loops that give clients compelling reasons to create, share, return, connect, and invite others.

- Own the roadmap and full product lifecycle, from opportunity identification and validation through development, launch, analysis, and iteration.

- Establish clear goals and measurement frameworks for the portfolio, including engagement, sharing, earned reach, referral behaviour, network effects, and incremental client growth.

- Use quantitative analysis, experimentation, user research, and broader consumer-product trends to uncover opportunities and determine what to build next.

- Develop and run a high-velocity experimentation program, using each launch to generate insights and inform future product decisions.

- Partner closely with design, engineering, data, marketing, compliance, and other product teams to deliver experiences that are useful, intuitive, trustworthy, and distinctly Wealthsimple.

- Maintain a strong understanding of social platforms, consumer apps, online communities, and emerging behaviours, translating relevant patterns into original ideas for Wealthsimple.

SKILLS YOU BRING

- Experience building and growing consumer-facing digital products, ideally within a high-growth mobile app.

- A record of owning meaningful product outcomes rather than simply delivering features or managing a roadmap.

- Strong consumer product judgment and an understanding of what makes experiences engaging, repeatable, and shareable.

- Experience with product-led growth, including areas such as viral loops, referrals, network effects, social sharing, engagement, or retention.

- Strong analytical and experimentation skills, with the ability to translate behavioural data into product insights and decisions.

- Experience taking products through the full development cycle, from early discovery and definition through launch, measurement, and optimization.

- The ability to develop a clear strategic point of view while moving quickly and learning through execution.

- Strong cross-functional leadership and communication skills, with the ability to align teams around the problem, desired outcome, and path forward.

- A high degree of ownership, curiosity, and comfort operating in an ambitious and evolving product area.

- Experience using AI tools to accelerate research, prototyping, analysis, documentation, or product development.

NICE TO HAVES

- Experience building social products, communities, profiles, feeds, creator tools, or sharing mechanics.

- Experience developing products with measurable network effects or organic acquisition loops.

- Familiarity with personal finance, investing, or how people discuss money online.

WHY WEALTHSIMPLE?

🌸 Top-tier health benefits and life insurance

📈 Long-term group savings with employer match, through Wealthsimple for Business

🌴 20 vacation days, 4 wellness days, and unlimited sick and mental health days per year

✈️ 90 days away: work outside Canada for up to 90 days per year

👥 Employee resource groups, including Rainbow (2SLGBTQ), Women of WS, and Black at WS

🌎 We are a hybrid team with over 1,500 employees across North America. The people are one of the best parts of working here: you'll collaborate with incredibly talented, curious, and driven teammates who are deeply committed to doing great work.

ICYMI

Technology & Innovation at Wealthsimple: We move quickly and build thoughtfully. That means we're always looking for better ways to work — whether that's new tools, AI, or rethinking how we approach a problem. We don't expect you to have all the answers, but we do expect curiosity and a willingness to evolve alongside the products we're building.

Inclusion Statement: We're building products for a diverse world, and we need a diverse team to do it well. We strongly encourage applications from everyone, regardless of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

Accessibility Statement: We're committed to an accessible hiring experience. If you need any accommodations throughout the interview process, please let us know — we'll work with you to make sure you have what you need. We also welcome any feedback on how we can better accommodate candidates with accessibility needs.

AI in Hiring: We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our team but don't replace human judgment – all final hiring decisions are made by people. If you have questions about how your data is used, reach out to us.

roles.title: Senior Product Manager, Caper Recommendations & Personalization
roles.location: Canada - Remote (ON, AB, BC, or NS Only)
roles.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

Caper is at the forefront of Physical AI, building smart shopping carts that sense and respond to the real world in real time. By bringing intelligence onto the cart, Caper digitizes the entire in-store shopping journey, turning every trip into an interactive, personalized experience from the first item added to checkout. Our plug-and-play technology requires no store renovation or operational overhaul — retailers simply add Caper Carts and instantly upgrade their stores into connected, intelligent shopping environments. Caper is one of the fastest-growing retail automation technology products in the market and is already widely adopted across the industry.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own recommendations and personalization on the Caper Cart. In this role, you will define how the cart decides what to show each shopper, when to show it, and how it adapts to who they are. Every recommendation, moment of inspiration, and ranking decision on the cart screen runs through the systems you will build and refine.

This is a unique opportunity to sit at the intersection of recommendation systems, machine learning, and a physical shopping experience that unfolds in real time as a customer moves through a store. You will blend ML and data science work with hands-on UX design thinking, partnering closely with Instacart's discovery and personalization platforms while shaping a first-of-its-kind experience for the Caper customer. You will report to the Group Product Manager for Caper Customer Value and work alongside a tight-knit team of three product managers, with broad cross-functional reach across Engineering, Data Science, Design, Ads, and Operations.

About the Job

Set and own the vision for recommendations and personalization on Caper. Caper turns the store itself into a personalization surface, where every item added and every step through the store is a chance to show something useful in the moment. You will drive Engagement as a primary pillar metric — growing customer interactions, building monetizable surfaces, and diversifying the content mix to serve savings, discovery, and health-focused shoppers.

Own the system that decides what to show and when. Mature recommendation and item ranking using machine learning, including LLM-based techniques, and use real-time signals — cart location and motion, lists, search, and Instacart personalization data — to deliver content at the moments it is most relevant rather than constant or intrusive.

Drive AI-first innovation to expand what Caper shows shoppers. Ship net-new content types with nuanced product information and pairings tailored to each individual, and lead the architecture for capturing real-time, in-session signals that make personalization feel genuinely intelligent.

Champion a high-quality, intuitive shopping experience by partnering closely with Design to translate complex personalization logic into interactions that feel simple and natural on the cart screen. Spend time in labs and partner stores to observe real shopper behavior, test features, and iterate quickly based on what you learn.

Run a fast, experiment-driven roadmap and serve as the product lead for recommendations and personalization across the organization — aligning senior stakeholders on strategy, tradeoffs, and progress, and partnering cross-functionally with Engineering, Data Science, Design, Ads, and Operations from discovery through launch with clear PRDs and measurable success criteria.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

3+ years of product management experience or equivalent practical experience

Experience partnering with ML or data science teams to ship models into a production consumer product

Experience defining and driving engagement or relevance metrics, and using experimentation to move them

Demonstrated ability to leverage data and quantitative analysis to make sound decisions in ambiguous environments

Track record of close partnership with UX design teams and applying strong design thinking practices throughout the product development process

Strong communication and influencing skills, with experience presenting to large groups and aligning multiple senior stakeholders on strategy and tradeoffs

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building recommendation, personalization, ranking, or search products

Experience with consumer-facing hardware, IoT, or physical retail products

Familiarity with retail, grocery, ads, or marketplace recommendation systems

#LI-Remote

Instacart provides highly market-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy here. Currently, we are only hiring in the following provinces: Ontario, Alberta, British Columbia, and Nova Scotia.

Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please read more about our benefits offerings here.

For Canadian based candidates, the base pay ranges for a successful candidate are listed below.

CAN

$194,000—$204,500 CAD
